city_file.dataset: Dallas Police Department, Police Incidents (dallasopendata.com qv6i-rri7)
city_file.grain: one row per victim per offense (servnumid); incidentnum groups them
stated_exclusions: offenses where a victim or suspect is under 17
city_file.family_violence: absent: the family flag is never true in any year, and the assault preliminary-investigation offenses are named '*NON FAMILY VIOLENCE'
city_file.records_system: UCR fields filled through June 2018 and empty from July 2018; nibrs_code filled for every row from January 2017

nibrs_files.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer, NIBRS incident data by state, key nibrs/incident/<year>/TX-<year>.zip via /LATEST/s3/signedurl

skipped.DALLAS_Crime_Data/Dallas_PD_Incidents (A: personal copy, owner account at TAMUCC
skipped.chez-ydz4 Police Person: same filter as incidents; victim age at offense links to incident rows only by incident, race and sex
